title: Candidate-Scoped Bottom Liquid Sensible-Energy Evaluator

invariants.assessment: The implementation adds one reusable process primitive and one runtime composition evaluator; it creates no second SWAP kernel or use-case-specific model version.
Neither production module performs file, parser, path, format or file-unit I/O.
Immutable enthalpy parameters, accepted-route carrier input, physical continuation state and candidate energy result remain distinct data categories.
No energy accumulator, carrier sample or enthalpy bookkeeping is added to persistent per-column continuation state.
The evaluator consumes the existing worker-local EB-I13 carrier snapshot and creates only call-local arithmetic/result data.
Cost and temporary storage scale with accepted carrier samples only; no heavy solver object is attached per logical column.
Only an already-materialized completed EB-I13 candidate is accepted. Rejected full/half/retry routes are excluded by the qualified carrier lifecycle.
Energy is evaluated from retained accepted provenance with no Richards or thermal reconstruction solve.
The evaluator is interval-shape agnostic and consumes generic EB-I13 sample intervals without calendar assumptions.
No fixed coupling-window duration or midnight boundary is assumed.
The capability is candidate-scoped and deliberately defers accepted publication to the transactional runtime/coupler integration layer.
Head and water-flux interface contracts are untouched; the evaluator only reads the already-authoritative signed bottom transfer.
Water transfer is never recalculated, repaired or rebooked. Missing external thermal provenance makes energy incomplete while hydrologic mass remains unchanged.
Groundwater-interface sensitivities and their production path are unchanged.
The evaluator contains no solver dependency and requires O(Nsample) arithmetic only. The qualification workflow reruns EB-I13 solve-count parity.
The capability is an optional sparse evaluator and allocates no permanent energy object for inactive MultiSWAP columns.
No MODFLOW cell, tile fraction or area aggregation appears in the evaluator.
Inward external water remains thermally incomplete rather than being interpreted as a specific groundwater/deep-vadose source inside SWAP.
Energy is attached diagnostically to the same accepted transfer amount. No component-transition water storage is created or discarded.
The evaluator depends on the accepted-route carrier contract rather than Full Richards or HeadCalc internals, leaving equivalent alternative-solver publication possible.
The liquid sensible-enthalpy primitive is the exact qualified EB-I04 source blob and is reused by the runtime composition instead of duplicating its algebra.
No HeadCalc arrays or solver-internal hydraulics are visible to the evaluator.
The terminal-donor rule is the explicit EB-I14 reference numerical accounting policy; it does not silently alter a physical option or the soil-temperature governing equation.
Evaluation cost is bounded by the bounded carrier sample count; incomplete external provenance returns immediately without additional solving.
The current-reference terminal rule remains explicitly available and is tested at O0 and O2; higher-order alternatives remain separate future policies.
Result status, completeness, total availability, local subtotal and sample-class counts provide explicit diagnostics for normal and incomplete routes.
The evaluator incurs cost only when explicitly invoked; optional energy accounting adds no state or compute to inactive columns.
External donor-temperature source mapping and system composition remain outside the evaluator and SWAP kernel.
No .swp input, day boundary, calendar start or direct MODFLOW assumption is introduced.
This audit explicitly assesses EB-I15 against all thirty architecture invariants before any runtime publication work.

qualification_attacks: two accepted local samples use their own terminal donor temperatures and sum sample-wise
adversarial aggregate-water-times-final-temperature shortcut gives a different answer
changing local start temperature while keeping terminal temperature fixed cannot change energy
exact zero transfer is complete and exactly zero without donor temperature
mixed local-outflow plus external-inflow candidate exposes no complete total
local subtotal remains diagnostic but cannot masquerade as total when external donor is missing
invalid candidate and invalid enthalpy properties expose no total
O0 and O2 test output is exact-identical
EB-I13 carrier, hydrologic ledger, solver-count, transaction and restart preservation gates rerun
hard_nonclaims: automatic invocation by the serialized runtime
external groundwater or deep-vadose donor temperature binding
governing thermal feedback from advective boundary energy
closed soil or land-column energy balance
